title: Recurring Model-Version-Aware Adaptive DA-LinTS State Management
relationship_to_completed_study: Separate recurrence study; it does not modify or rerun the completed one-way study.
manifest_protocol: One fixed 400-episode manifest per seed, generated before either policy; image indices, attacks, epsilons, torch episode randomness, and fresh-state sampling seeds are matched.

restorations: C restores standard state accumulated in A
D restores robust_alone state accumulated in B

primary_endpoint: Phase-D mean reward: isolation minus full_reset per seed
secondary_endpoint: Phase-C paired metrics under restored standard state
equality_gates: Phase A exact equality before B
Phase B exact equality before C
advance_version_isolation_only_if: at least 8 of 10 positive Phase-D reward differences
mean Phase-D recovery and defended-accuracy differences >= 0
significance_statement: No statistical-significance claim is made from 10 seeds.
